title: Duplicate Glucose
symptom: After inserting a new sensor, duplicate glucose readings appear in AAPS, even after switching from xDrip to Dexcom app. Previously fixed by resetting database without pulling data from Nightscout.
cause: xDrip sends data from previous session with different timestamps, causing duplicate BGs.
fix: Switch to Dexcom app and do not use xDrip+ as a Dexcom collector for AAPS. Also, manually delete duplicate BGs on AAPS.
evidence_quote: it's a bug on xDrip side we cannot resolve. xDrip sends data from previous session with different timestamps it is already mentioned in release notes you have to switch to dexcom app and do not use xDrip+ as a dexcom collector for AAPS
